businesses.business: packaged protein and low-carb nutrition foods

offering_description.value: Markets and sells branded protein and low-carb snacks and ready-to-drink shakes to consumers through grocery, mass, club and online retailers. It outsources manufacturing to contract food producers and focuses on brand, product development and sales.

primary_products.value: protein bars; ready-to-drink protein shakes; protein powders; snack chips; low-carb baking mixes

customer_segment.value: B2C: health-conscious consumers and athletes buying through retail stores and online; B2B: grocery, mass merchandise, club, convenience and online retailers, wholesale distributors

end_markets.value: packaged foods; sports and fitness nutrition; health and wellness; weight management

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded snacks and shakes sold to retailers, distributors and online shoppers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs, markets and sells branded foods made by contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and distributors

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily United States, with smaller sales in Canada and some other countries

specialization.value: related lines: protein bars, shakes, snack chips and baking products sharing nutrition-focused brands and retail channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: key account sales teams selling to large grocery, mass and club retailers; distributors / dealers: wholesale food distributors serving smaller grocery and convenience stores; third-party retail: grocery, mass, club, drug and convenience stores; online: retailer e-commerce sites, online marketplaces and the company's own website
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food labeling and nutrient content claim rules and FTC advertising rules govern its products and marketing

notes: Exact geographic mix and the share of sales by product line are approximate.
